page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at the top, page number at the top right. Marginal notes in the right margin, beside the lines they belong to. Signature at the foot, lower centre.

main_text.p: prendecim annos natus, venundatus est. Interea rebus in Agypto aduersus famem bene compositus, orbem terrae gravis fru-menti inopia quatiebat. Qua necessitate compulsus Iacob, filios in Aegyptum misit, Benjamin tantum secum domi retento. Igitur Ioseph rerum potentem, penes quemGen.41. annonae arbitrium erat, fratres adeunt & more regio adorant. Quibus ille visis, calide agnitionem dissimulas, hostiliter eos venisse, & subdole loca explorare arguebat. Angebatur autem quod Benjamin fratrem non videbat. Res ergo in id deduc-ta, ut præsentiam ejus pollicerentur: nimirum ut ex eo quæreretur, an isti exploran-di causa Aegyptum intrassent. Ad promissi autem fidem Simeo obses traditur, ipsis frumentum gratis datum. Rursum igitur reuertentes, Benjamin, ut convenerat, deduxerunt. Tum se cognoscedum[?] lo-seph fratribus præbuit, non sine pudore male merentium.Iosephfratribus Ita eos oneratos frumen-to multisque donatos domum remisit,agnitus Gen.42.[?] præmonens quinque adhuc annos famem futuram: cum patre atque omni progenie ac familia ad se commigrarent. Igitur Iacob in Aegyptum descendit, AegyptiisGen.46.[?]

page.notes: The scan is of moderate quality with some show-through and ink damage at the right margin. Marginal note numbers and the page number are partly obscured and are marked [?]. The word "cognoscedum" is printed as read and is probably a printing error for "cognoscendum". The page ends mid-sentence with no catchword. Long s is transcribed as s throughout. Wordings of the marginal references are uncertain.
